verdict.rationale: The GitHub items (github.com/pnpm/pnpm) show pnpm's source is publicly hosted and readable, which covers the 'read the source' part of the story. Nothing in the pack names the license, and the `pnpm licenses list` items describe auditing dependency licenses, not pnpm's own license, so they are not credited. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of an OSI-approved open license for pnpm itself, and documentation or independent corroboration of the licensing terms.
